newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Six qualify for Banco de Venezuela sale.
newsitem.headline: Six qualify for Banco de Venezuela sale.

text.p: Venezuela's State Deposits Guarantee Fund Fogade announced Monday that six potential bidders had qualified to participate in the sale of state bank Banco de Venezuela.
The six include Banco Santander SA, which had shown strong interest in buying the bank until a previous auction was postponed in late August.
The other qualified bidders are Banco Bilbao Vizcaya SA, Credicorp Ltd, Debis International Trading, Infisa CA, Grupo Saieh and Organizacion Luis Carlos Sarmiento.
Fogade has still not set a firm date for the bank's sale, which was postponed in August when bidders withdrew as uncertainties about the sale grew.
Fogade had set a minimum price of $275 million for the bank at the previous auction.
The government has said it will reserve about 10 percent of the bank's stock for sale on the local stock market.
